section_title: Account & Privacy Support Policy - Account Assistance
chunk_content: NovaCart - Account & Privacy Support Policy Account Assistance - Customers can request help with account access, profile information, and account-related issues. - Account-specific changes may require identity verification. Security - NovaCart support will never ask customers to disclose passwords, OTPs, card PINs, CVV values, or other authentication secrets. - Sensitive credentials must not be stored in support tickets or conversation notes. Privacy - Customer information should only be accessed when necessary to resolve a support request. - Support systems should limit customer-data access according to role and authorization. Escalation - Suspected account compromise, unauthorized transactions, or sensitive security incidents should be escalated for human investigation.

NovaCart - Cancellation Policy Before Shipment - Customers may request cancellation while an order is in an eligible pre-shipment state. - Cancellation depends on the current order status and may fail if processing has already progressed. After Shipment - Orders that have already been shipped generally cannot be cancelled through the normal cancellation process. - Customers may need to follow the applicable return or refund process after delivery. Confirmation - A cancellation request is not considered successful until the system confirms the order as cancelled. - Support should verify the order status before confirming cancellation.

NovaCart - Frequently Asked Questions General - NovaCart is an online shopping platform offering electronics, home accessories, fashion items, and everyday products. - Customers can contact support for order, payment, delivery, refund, cancellation, and account-related questions. - Customers should keep their order ID available when contacting support about a specific order. Orders - Customers can check order status using their order ID. - Order statuses may include Placed, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Cancelled, or Failed. - If an order has been shipped, the estimated delivery date is shown in the order information. Refunds and Cancellations - Refund eligibility depends on the product and applicable refund policy. - Cancellation availability depends on the current order status. - Orders already shipped may not be cancellable through the normal cancellation flow. Account - Customers should use the email address associated with their NovaCart account for account-specific assistance. - Customers should never share passwords, OTPs, card PINs, or other authentication secrets with support.

NovaCart - Payment Policy Payment Verification - Payment status must be verified from the payment system before confirming a transaction as successful or failed. - Possible payment states include Pending, Successful, Failed, Refunded, and Reversed. Failed Payments - If a payment fails, customers may retry using an available payment method. - Customers should never share card numbers, CVV, PINs, OTPs, or passwords with support. Payment Deducted but Order Missing - When money is deducted but an order is not successfully created, support should check both payment and order records. - If reconciliation is required, create a support ticket with the relevant payment reference and customer context. Refunds - Refund timing depends on when the refund is initiated and the payment provider's processing time. - Support must use verified payment information when communicating refund status.

section_title: Refund Policy - Payment Deducted but Order Failed
chunk_content: NovaCart - Refund Policy Eligibility - Eligible products may be returned or refunded within 7 calendar days of delivery, subject to product-specific conditions. - Products must generally be unused and returned with applicable accessories and original packaging where required. - Some products may be marked non-returnable or non-refundable. Refund Processing - After an eligible return is approved and verified, NovaCart initiates the refund. - Refund processing normally takes 5 - 7 business days after refund initiation. - The final credit time can depend on the payment provider or bank. Payment Deducted but Order Failed - If payment was deducted but the order failed, support must first verify payment and order status. - If payment is confirmed but no successful order

Deducted but Order Failed - If payment was deducted but the order failed, support must first verify payment and order status. - If payment is confirmed but no successful order exists, the issue may require payment reconciliation and a support ticket. - Support must not claim that a refund was initiated unless the system confirms it. Exceptions - Non-refundable products are not eligible for a standard refund unless an applicable exception is confirmed. - Damaged or incorrect items should be reported as soon as possible with the requested evidence.

NovaCart - Shipping & Delivery Policy Shipping - NovaCart processes orders after payment and order confirmation. - Shipping timelines vary by destination, product availability, and logistics conditions. Delivery Status - Customers can request current delivery status using their order ID. - Typical statuses include Processing, Shipped, Out for Delivery, and Delivered. - An estimated delivery date is not a guarantee and may change. Delayed Delivery - If an order is delayed beyond the expected delivery window, support should verify the latest delivery information. - Repeated or significant delivery issues may be converted into a support ticket. NovaCart - Customer Support Guidelines Support Principles - Give accurate, concise, and grounded answers. - Use the knowledge base for policy and FAQ questions. - Use verified business tools for live order, payment, delivery, and ticket information. - Do not invent order status, payment status, refund status, delivery dates, or policy details. Missing Information - Ask for the minimum information required, such as an order ID or payment reference. - If required information cannot be obtained, explain the limitation and provide the appropriate next step. Tool Failures - If a business tool fails or returns an unavailable result, do not fabricate the result. - Use a meaningful fallback and create or escalate a support ticket when manual investigation is required.

Human Escalation - Escalate when the customer explicitly requests a human, the issue cannot be reliably resolved, a tool repeatedly fails, a complaint requires manual investigation, or available information is insufficient. - Preserve relevant conversation context, customer details, order/payment references, issue summary, and attempted actions. Conversation Context - Use previous conversation information when resolving follow-up questions. - If a customer provides an order ID and later refers to 'my order', use stored context when confidence is sufficient. - Do not assume an entity when context is ambiguous; ask for clarification.

section_title: What is your 30-day refund policy? - NovaCart 30-Day Refund Policy & Return Terms
chunk_content:
What is your 30-day refund policy?
NovaCart 30-day refund policy: Customers are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of delivery for all eligible items. Under NovaCart's 30-day refund policy, items must be unused, in their original packaging, and returned with proof of purchase. Once your returned item is received and inspected at our warehouse, refunds are approved and processed within 5 to 7 business days directly to the original payment method.

section_title: Refund Policy - Return Conditions and Non-Refundable Items
chunk_content:
NovaCart Return Exceptions & Non-Refundable Products:
Standard electronics, apparel, and unopened accessories qualify for the 30-day refund window. Personalized products, software licenses, and opened consumable goods are marked non-returnable and non-refundable. For items that arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect, report the issue within 48 hours of delivery with photo evidence for an expedited replacement or immediate full refund.

section_title: Shipping Terms & Delivery Information - Carrier and Timelines
chunk_content:
NovaCart Shipping Terms and Carrier Tracking:
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, while Express shipping delivers within 1-2 business days. All orders are shipped via trusted carriers including FedEx, UPS, and DHL. Once your order ships, an automated tracking number (e.g., FEDEX-9928172) is issued with live transit updates. Estimated delivery dates are displayed directly in your order status portal.

section_title: Order Cancellation Rules - Pre-Shipment Cancellation Windows
chunk_content:
NovaCart Order Cancellation Rules:
Customers may cancel an order free of charge at any time while the order status is 'PENDING' or 'PROCESSING'. Once an order transitions to 'SHIPPED' or 'DELIVERED', it can no longer be cancelled; instead, the customer may initiate a return under our 30-day refund policy upon delivery. When an eligible pre-shipment order is cancelled, an automatic refund is initiated immediately to the original payment method.
